title: Acceptance probability after adding a query
statement: Let $T$ be a nonadaptive function tester with three query positions, and let $f$ be a function from its domain to its codomain. The tester obtained by padding $T$ with a fourth, unused query position has the same acceptance probability on $f$ as $T$.
